issues.title: Add keyboard shortcuts for switching between agents
issues.body:
Switching between agents needs the mouse right now.

### Proposal

- `Alt+1` … `Alt+6` jump to the plant in that pot
- `Alt+←` / `Alt+→` go to the previous/next agent

See also the [WAI-ARIA keyboard guide](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/practices/keyboard-interface/).

issues.title: Search results page shows duplicate entries when the query contains special characters such as umlauts, quotes or a trailing slash
issues.body:
Searching for `café`, `"quoted"` or `docs/` lists some results twice.

2. Scroll down: the first three hits come again
